title: Tech Tuesday: Has Technology Become Boring?
desc: Look, I love technology. I wouldn’t be writing Tech Tuesday every week if I didn’t. But lately, I’ve been feeling a little… bored. Not with technology as a whole, but with the gadgets that used to get me excited about it. A new smartphone launches, and it’s faster than last year’s phone. A new laptop comes out, and it’s faster than last year’s laptop. A new TV launches, and somehow it’s faster than last year’s TV. It’s all technically impressive. […]
